extract_batch: archive size cap triggers error

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, SecurityLimits, ExtractInputKind
from xberg import XbergError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        inputs = [ExtractInput(bytes=Path("text/fake_text.txt").read_bytes(), kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")]
        config = ExtractionConfig(security_limits=SecurityLimits(max_content_size=1))
        await extract_batch(inputs, config)
    except XbergError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
